MAIN FINDING: probe 50 changed the structure of the choice. V_pub is now a NON-CI file (exp85a 0.958), so the pair {exp85a, exp75} splits the levers: cap 6 + K in one file, CI only in the other. It is first on bronze in every run with private CI mean >= -0.0003 (.77-.91 bronze, .50-.74 silver). For comparison: {V_pub, #37} .68-.85; the JT-literal {V_pub, exp70g} is dominated everywhere; {exp85a, exp87a} wins silver only when cap is tight; the #37+K hedge exp89u is dominated by exp75. If a CI file (exp87a or exp89r) becomes the top display, {V_CI, exp75} ties {V_nonCI, exp75} on bronze at a tight CI prior and has better silver/EV, but it trails by .03-.08 at CI sd >= .0015, so card v4 shows both. PROPOSED: card v4 with V_pub rule v4 (order: the '0u' chain, then fewer levers, then non-CI, then the earlier submit; a '0' read is unresolved, never 'lower'); the exp75 partner floor relaxed to >= 0.954 when V_pub is non-CI; the morning scan's exp89s (K + DIS 2.25, no SEC) preferred as M2 and as the V_pub twin of the SEC stack (the in-sample lab puts SEC at -0.0016; with an SEC mean of -0.0008, exp89s + exp75 gains +0.04 bronze over exp89q + exp75); the non-CI M2 dummy goes before the CI M1. A short Russian 15:00 MSK draft is included (R26F-8). 743006 (an unverified participant: the private test is one embryo) and a base rate quoted in that thread (about 3 in 4 public gains hold on private in code competitions) both support the split. Metric arithmetic: K costs -0.0008 mechanically on any embryo, so it needs >= 29% of its +0.0028 public raw gain to transfer; DIS 2.25 gains ~+0.0006-0.0007 mechanically. No new mechanism reaches the bar, and there is no E10 trigger. Output: research/wf_ideas_v4/round26/scan_hyp_finals.json and .notes.md.

findings.what: SPLIT-LEVER PAIR. Probe 50 changed the structure of the finals choice. V_pub is now a NON-CI file (exp85a = cap 6 + K, 0.958). The pair {exp85a, exp75} splits the levers: V_pub carries cap 6 + K, and exp75 (= #37 + CI) carries only CI. Scoring is best-of-two, so each file insures the other. In R25, V_pub (exp79a) already held CI, so exp75 duplicated CI and lost its edge at CI sd >= 0.0015; that objection no longer applies. mc26 result: {exp85a, exp75} is FIRST on bronze in every exp85a run with private CI mean >= -0.0003: .77-.90 (base .828/.598), versus A {exp85a,#37} .68-.85, C {exp85a,exp70g} .57-.85, {exp85a,exp79a} .63-.89 and {exp85a,exp87a} .66-.88. It also leads on silver except in the cap-tight C-norm runs, where {exp85a,exp87a} is +0.02-0.04. B beats A only while the private CI mean stays above about -0.0004 (at CI -0.0005/0.001: A .747 > B .734). The public CI read is +0.001 (UP 33) and the lab is in-sample, so a negative mean would need CI to flip sign on the private embryo. The same holds for a non-CI stack as V_pub: {exp89q, exp75} and {exp89s, exp75} are first on bronze in every run (.79-.91).

findings.what: exp89s = exp85a + ILP_DISAPPEARANCE_WEIGHT 2.25 WITHOUT SEC (cap 6 + K + DIS = cap + 2 levers, within the depth cap). It is the same file the parallel round-26 morning scan built in a scratch mirror (sha 8ed72e32), and it is not in experiments/ yet. From the finals side it is the preferred V_pub candidate whenever DIS reads '+' on the night stack. The night stack exp89q/r carries our retrained secondary: SEC has no public read, all 7 earlier LB weight swaps were negative, and the in-sample dummy lab puts exp89p at -0.0016 vs exp85a. mc26 with SEC mean -0.0008: {exp89s, exp75} .851/.646 vs {exp89q, exp75} .812/.579 (+0.04 bronze). Mechanism: DIS 2.25 cuts nodes by 0.7% (exp88a -0.73%; exp89q vs exp89p -0.68%), which by the metric formula adj J = J*(1-0.1*dN/N_est) is worth ~+0.0006-0.0007 on ANY embryo. The edge churn (1.45%) has an unknown sign; the lab shows DIS -0.0008 on exp70g and +0.0004 on exp89p. Runtime: the same as exp85a (ILP weight only; hidden L ~7.0-7.2 h, non-CI).

findings.what: Discussion 743006: g john rao (a participant, unverified), 28 Sep 12:27Z: 'there are two embryos in the hidden test set. the first one is private and the second is public (but it could be a mix split of the two embryos as well)'. The same thread holds two earlier facts. Host replies, as quoted by Georgy Mamarin: the hidden test shares no embryos with train, is roughly train-sized and follows the same protocol/instrument. And a base rate over ~1,000 past competitions: a submission that raised a team's public best also beat the replaced one on private ~8 in 10 times, ~3 in 4 in code competitions. Use: (a) every lever read is a single-embryo read, and private is one draw of the embryo effect, so lever sd is larger and splitting levers across the two files (R26F-1) gains; mc26 {exp85a,exp75} rises with CI sd (.828 -> .832) while the pairs that duplicate CI fall. (b) The 3/4 base rate is consistent with the K posterior used, P(K_priv > 0) ~0.77 (N(+0.0009, 0.0012)).

findings.what: Metric arithmetic for the card's lever-risk column. K: READMIT 0.94 adds +0.84% nodes (exp85c dummy), which costs 0.1*0.0084*~0.95 = -0.0008 on ANY embryo, so the public +0.002 display implies a raw edge/lowrefine gain of ~+0.0028 on the public embryo. K is positive on private only if >= ~29% of that raw gain transfers (0.0008/0.0028); the in-sample dummy lab also shows K at +0.0013. DIS 2.25 on the K base (exp89q vs exp89p): -0.68% nodes, worth ~+0.0006 mechanically on any embryo, and exp89q's net node change vs exp70g is +0.02% (node-neutral, as JT reported for his knobs). Cap 6: public +0.002 (UP 127) against an in-sample lab -0.0006, and the two supersets (cap 8, cap 12+fc2) each read -0.001. That is non-monotone, so part of cap 6's +0.002 is likely luck. SEC: no public read until exp89p reads (~07:45-08:35 UTC 29 Sep); in-sample lab -0.0016. Risk ranking for the card: cap 6 high, SEC high, K medium (two bases, one embryo, known mechanical floor -0.0008), DIS medium-low (+0.0007 mechanical floor minus the unknown edge churn), CI medium-low.

Сейчас отмечены #37 (0.954) + #38 (0.953). Это худшая пара во всех расчётах.
1) РЕКОМЕНДУЮ (самая устойчивая по бронзе): {<V_nonCI: exp85a 56629533, 0.958 | или ночной/утренний файл без CI, если он выше по правилу ниже>, exp75 <ref, паблик>}.
   Как это работает: основной файл несёт ручки (cap 6 + K), exp75 = #37 + CI несёт только CI. На привате засчитывается лучший из двух. Если ручки не перенесутся на приватный эмбрион, остаётся exp75; если не перенесётся CI, остаётся основной файл.
   Модель (оценочная, решаете вы): бронза ~0.77-0.91, серебро ~0.50-0.74. Пара первая по бронзе во всех прогонах, пока средний эффект CI на привате не ниже -0.0004 (на паблике у CI было +0.001).
2) АЛЬТЕРНАТИВА (выше серебро и матожидание, если верить, что CI переносится точно): {<V_CI: exp87a или лучший файл с CI>, exp75}. Бронза ~0.75-0.93, серебро ~0.59-0.78. При широком разбросе CI (sd >= 0.0015) она на 0.03-0.08 ниже по бронзе, чем пара 1.
3) НЕ рекомендую: {основной, #37}, {основной, exp70g} и {основной, #37+K} (ниже по бронзе в каждом прогоне), текущие {#37, #38} (бронза ~0.48-0.66, серебро ~0.10-0.23).
Риски рычагов: cap 6: паблик +0.002, лаборатория -0.0006, cap 8/12 на паблике по -0.001. K: паблик +0.002 и у JT на другом форке, но на том же эмбрионе; +0.84% узлов стоят -0.0008 на любом эмбрионе по формуле метрики. CI: паблик +0.001 <+ проба 51>. SEC: <чтение exp89p>; в лаборатории -0.0016. DIS 2.25: -0.7% узлов даёт ~+0.0007 бонуса по формуле; знак рёбер неизвестен.
По словам участника в 743006 (не подтверждено), приват = один эмбрион, паблик = другой. Значит, все наши чтения относятся к одному эмбриону, и разнести рычаги по двум файлам важнее.
Основной файл при равном паблике выбираю так: (1) файл, после которого нас обогнали команды (UP-тест, значит, он выше без округления); (2) меньше рычагов; (3) без CI (тогда CI остаётся в exp75); (4) отправлен раньше.
Если exp75 не прочитан, выдал ошибку, CI не отработал или exp75 ниже 0.954: пара {основной, #37}.
